description: This file contains utility functions and classes for linear algebra operations in the ATen/native namespace of PyTorch, including tensor cloning, broadcasting, shape validation, and order compatibility checks.

methods.name: expect_resolved_conj
methods.description: Returns a tensor that is either a resolved conjugate or a borrowed reference, depending on whether the input tensor is conjugated.

methods.name: batched_matrix_contiguous_strides
methods.description: Calculates strides for batched matrices, optionally fixing for Fortran or C contiguity.

methods.name: cloneBatchedColumnMajor
methods.description: Clones a tensor into batched column-major format efficiently.

methods.name: borrow_else_clone
methods.description: Returns a borrowed tensor or a cloned copy, with optional contiguity.

methods.name: copyBatchedColumnMajor
methods.description: Creates a copy of a batched matrix tensor with specified batch size and number of rows.

methods.name: batchCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of batches in a batched matrix tensor.

methods.name: matrixStride
methods.description: Computes the number of elements in a matrix within a batched tensor.

methods.name: checkIsMatrix
methods.description: Validates that a tensor has at least 2 dimensions.

methods.name: squareCheckInputs
methods.description: Checks that a tensor is a batch of square matrices.

methods.name: checkInputsSolver
methods.description: Validates shapes of matrices A and B for linear solvers.

methods.name: is_row_or_column_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is contiguous or transpose contiguous.

methods.name: to_transpose_type
methods.description: Determines the transpose type based on contiguity and conjugation flags.

methods.name: batch_iterator_with_broadcasting
methods.description: Iterates over batched tensors with broadcasting, applying a provided function.

methods.name: _get_epsilon
methods.description: Returns machine epsilon for float and double types.

methods.name: linearSolveCheckInputs
methods.description: Checks device and dtype compatibility for linear solve functions.

methods.name: checkFloatingOrComplex
methods.description: Ensures tensor is floating or complex type, optionally excluding low precision types.

methods.name: checkAllSameDim
methods.description: Verifies all tensors in a list have the same specified dimension.

methods.name: _linalg_broadcast_batch_dims
methods.description: Computes broadcasted batch dimensions for two tensors.

methods.name: broadcast_batch_size
methods.description: Calculates broadcasted batch sizes for two tensors.

methods.name: _move_to_end
methods.description: Permutes tensor axes to move specified axes to the end.

methods.name: _parse_qr_mode
methods.description: Parses QR mode string into compute_q and reduced flags.

methods.name: _compute_geometry_for_Q
methods.description: Calculates sizes, strides, and number of columns for Q in QR decomposition.

methods.name: svd_uses_cusolver
methods.description: Checks if cuSolver is used for SVD on CUDA tensors.

methods.name: same_stride_to
methods.description: Creates a tensor with the same strides as the original, but with new options.

methods.name: create_dim_backshift_permutation
methods.description: Creates permutation to move two axes to the end.

methods.name: create_reverse_permutation
methods.description: Creates a permutation that reverses a given permutation.

methods.name: computeLRWorkDim
methods.description: Calculates workspace size for MAGMA/LAPACK routines.

methods.name: checkUplo
methods.description: Validates 'U' or 'L' input for matrix uplo parameter.

methods.name: checkSameDevice
methods.description: Ensures tensors are on the same device.

methods.name: checkLinalgCompatibleDtype
methods.description: Checks if tensor dtypes are compatible for linear algebra operations.

methods.name: checkNotComplexTolerance
methods.description: Ensures tolerance tensor is not complex type.
